title: Simple Thrusters
description: This Mod currently adds 6 Different Thrusters
body:
This mod adds 6 Different Thrusters to Valkyrien Skies
Build idk a rocket or an airship or or or with it.

If you have bugs or ideas idk join my dc channel [very high quality.]

Why would you use it? Because there is atleast at the moment no actual alternative for mods like Create 6.0 , NO this mod does NOT need Create it just works with all create versions. 
I didnt test all but the code should just ignore it.

1.Simple Thruster, this is a simple on off thruster,you can set how much power it outputs 
    (Controlled Via Redstone)
    
2.Advanced Thruster, this has 15 different power levels which are controlled via the redstone signal strengt, you can freely set the base value.

3.Smart Thruster, it can be controlled via Computer craft allowing 255 different power levels


All of these thrusters have versions that apply the force at the center of gravity instead of the block position
